title: BABA-Bench: Evaluating Long-Horizon Patient-Advocacy Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.41076v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: An LLM agent that helps a patient get care must do two things. It must reach the correct outcome, and it must follow the necessary procedure. For example, the agent must get the patient's permission before it shares the patient's records. We introduce BABA-Bench, a benchmark of 47 interactive worlds. We built each world from a de-identified, real patient advocacy case that expert advocates reviewed. In each world, the agent must find hidden information and coordinate insurers, clinics, suppliers, pharmacies, and community organizations. The engine checks each action at the time the agent does it. It checks if the agent has permission, if the agent has evidence for the action, and if the action is prohibited. We evaluated 14 frontier models with three runs on each world, for a total of 1,974 runs. Agents often reached the correct outcome by an invalid route. translated_title: BABA-Bench：评估长时程患者维权智能体的基准测试
translated_abstract: 一个帮助患者获得医疗照护的LLM智能体必须做到两件事：既要达成正确的结果，又要遵循必要的程序。例如，智能体在分享患者病历之前必须先获得患者的许可。我们提出了BABA-Bench，这是一个包含47个交互式世界的基准测试，每个世界都基于经过专家倡导者审阅的去标识化真实患者维权案例构建。在每个世界中，智能体必须发现隐藏的信息，并协调保险公司、诊所、供应商、药房和社区组织。引擎会在智能体执行每个动作时进行实时检查：检查智能体是否拥有许可、是否有该动作所需的证据依据，以及该动作是否被禁止。我们评估了14个前沿模型，在每个世界中各运行三次，共计1,974次运行。智能体经常通过无效的途径达成正确的结果：在达成所有必需结果的921次运行中，有254次（28%）未遵循必要的程序。
tldr: BABA-Bench基于去标识化的真实患者维权案例构建了47个交互式测试环境，通过在智能体执行动作时实时检查其权限、证据与禁令，系统评估了LLM智能体能否在长时程患者维权任务中既达成正确结果又遵循必要程序，并发现28%成功达成目标的运行仍未遵循必要程序。
en_tdlr: BABA-Bench introduces 47 interactive worlds built from de-identified real patient advocacy cases, evaluating whether LLM agents can both achieve correct outcomes and follow necessary procedures in long-horizon care navigation via per-action checks of permission, evidence, and prohibitions, revealing that 28% of successful runs still violated procedural requirements.
